description: Timeseries of mention rate, citation rate, share of voice and average position for a citation tracker. Pass change_date (the day a change went live) to also get before_after: the runs completed runs before that date compared with the first runs on or after it, overall and per engine, with the counts behind every rate. comparable is false, and summary says so, when either side has fewer than 2 runs.

change_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), the day the change went live. A run that starts that day counts as after.

runs.description: Completed runs on each side of change_date.

tracker_id.description: The tracker's id from list_citation_trackers or create_citation_tracker.

name: citation_tracker_history
title: AI Citation Trend
